subject: Samira N. — competing offer, urgent decision window
messages:
From: Amy Chen <amy@greentree-talent.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Recruit Team <recruiting@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: URGENT: Candidate Samira N. — verbal accept window 72h (competing offer)

Hi Marissa / Karthik,

Quick heads-up — Samira Nadeem (ex-Infra lead at Nimbus Data) just received a verbal offer from a competing startup with a 72-hour decision window. They shared the main economics: $220k base, 25% target bonus, 0.25% equity (4-yr vest, 1-yr cliff), and a $20k sign-on. Candidate indicated Redwood remains their top choice given the product and team fit, but the competitor is pressing for a signed offer by Mon at 5pm PT.

I attached a short candidate summary and the competitor terms we captured. Can Redwood move quickly on a bridge/counter? Samira is asking whether we can improve the equity and provide a short signing window + DocuSign.

Key points:
- Senior infra background, strong attention to latency/cost tradeoffs (relevant to model serving infra)
- Prefers team + product over headline comp but needs a stronger long-term upside to decline the other offer

What would help: quick confirmation on whether we can: (1) increase equity band by ~30–40% above the usual L5 slot, (2) provide a modest sign-on bonus, or (3) accelerate vesting schedule for year 1.

Attaching: candidate_summary_samira.pdf

Amy
GreenTree Talent

---
Attachments: candidate_summary_samira.pdf (pdf)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: RE: URGENT: Candidate Samira N. — competing offer, urgent decision window

Team —

Samira is exactly the hire we scoped for the multiproduct infra push. Karthik, you interviewed her yesterday and flagged strong system design + shipping instincts. We should make a clean, fast counter that lands her within our L5 framework but gives meaningful upside to beat the other offer.

Proposed quick options (we can mix & match):
- Increase equity grant by 35% relative to top-of-band L5 (delta to be approved)
- One-time sign-on of $25k (paid in first payroll)
- Accelerated vesting: 25% at 12 months (instead of pro-rata across the year) — effectively a front-loaded Year 1

I need an OK from People + Jon (VP) for any uplift beyond standard band. If we can get a yes on equity uplift + sign-on, I will issue a DocuSign offer and request the candidate sign within 72 hours. I’m attaching the comp_band_L5 and a draft offer packet for edit.

Acute asks:
1) Lauren — can People Ops approve accelerated vesting and sign-on up to $25k without escalating to payroll/finance?
2) Jonas — can you approve a 35% equity uplift beyond top-of-band for this specific hire, given immediate team impact?

We need to move fast; candidate deadline is Mon 5pm PT.

Thanks —
Marissa
Director, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: comp_band_L5.pdf, draft_offer_marissa_v1.docx
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T09:36:00-07:00
Subject: RE: URGENT: Candidate Samira N. — competing offer, urgent decision window

Marissa / Karthik —

Thanks for the context. People Ops can support a fast counter with the following guardrails:
- Sign-on up to $25,000: APPROVED by People Ops for L5 hires when there is a documented competing offer and hiring manager justification. Payroll will need the retro tax paperwork but that’s routine.
- Accelerated vesting: we can front-load up to 25% at 12 months (we typically do 4-year schedule with 1-year cliff). For anything more front-loaded or one-time acceleration beyond 25% we need Finance sign-off.
- Equity uplift: increases up to 15% above top-of-band L5 can be approved by People Ops + Hiring Manager; anything >15% requires VP approval (Jonas). The 35% uplift you proposed will need Jonas' explicit sign-off.

If Jonas is comfortable with a 35% uplift, we can fast-track. Otherwise, we can offer 15% uplift + $25k sign-on + the 25% front-load. That combination should be competitive against the $20k sign-on + 0.25% equity the competitor is offering.

Operational note: please include the candidate's written competing offer terms and a short justification email (1–2 lines) when you seek the VP sign-off to keep the approval audit-friendly.

Happy to help prepare the final language.

—Lauren
Senior People Partner
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Samira Nadeem <samira.nadeem@gmail.com>, Amy Chen <amy@greentree-talent.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T10:21:00-07:00
Subject: Offer — Redwood Inference (Senior Infrastructure Engineer, L5) — time-limited counter

Samira / Amy —

Thanks again for the quick conversations today. We moved internally and want to share a formal counter. This is a time-limited offer to match the competing window; we’d appreciate a signature within 72 hours so we can get you onboarded quickly.

High-level terms (summary):
- Title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer (L5)
- Base salary: $210,000
- Target bonus: 20%
- Equity: 0.32% RSU grant (4-yr schedule, 25% vest at 12 months then pro-rata) — this reflects ~30% uplift vs top-of-band L5
- Sign-on: $25,000 (one-time, paid first payroll)
- Start date: flexible (typically 3–6 weeks)

We’ve uploaded the formal offer packet to DocuSign: https://docusign.net/Redwood/Envelope/12345 (link included again in attachments). The packet also contains the comp band and standard Redwood benefits + relocation guidance.

Please note: the equity uplift was approved by People Ops and the Hiring Manager. VP sign-off was requested and provided for this candidate due to immediate product impact. This counter is valid for 72 hours from receipt.

If you'd like an alternative vesting cadence (e.g., more front-loaded Year 1), note that in your response and we can evaluate — People Ops indicated a 25% front-load is possible.

Next step: sign the DocuSign envelope or reply here with any follow-ups. We can run expedited background checks and get you set up on the first day.

Warmly,
Marissa Cole
Director, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: docusign_offer_link.txt, draft_offer_marissa_v1.docx, comp_band_L5.pdf
From: Samira Nadeem <samira.nadeem@gmail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Amy Chen <amy@greentree-talent.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T12:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Offer — Redwood Inference (Senior Infrastructure Engineer, L5) — time-limited counter

Marissa —

Thank you — I really appreciate the fast response and the improved package. Redwood is my first choice based on the team alignment and scope. A couple quick clarifying asks before I sign:

1) Vesting cadence: is the 25% at 12 months guaranteed (then monthly thereafter)? I’d prefer a slightly more front-loaded Year 1 if possible (e.g., 30% at 12 months) because the competing offer has an aggressive early upside and early promotion track; if RED can do 30% front-load I can sign within the window.

2) Promotion/comp review cadence: any clarity on when L5->L6 promotion reviews typically happen for infra (12 months vs 18 months)? The competitor flagged a fast-promotion track.

If you can confirm either the 30% front-load OR provide a clear 12-month promotion review commit, I’m prepared to sign the DocuSign today.

Best,
Samira
